bio: FROM HARDENED LOCAL SCENE FAVOURITES TO INTERNATIONAL INDIE STARS, THE BETHS HAVE BECOME ONE OF THE MOST FEEL-GOOD SUCCESS STORIES TO EMERGE FROM NEW ZEALAND’S MUSIC SCENE IN RECENT YEARS. FORMED IN AUCKLAND IN 2015, THE BAND TAKES ITS NAME FROM SINGER, GUITARIST AND PRINCIPAL SONGWRITER ELIZABETH STOKES. THE ORIGINAL LINE-UP BROUGHT TOGETHER STOKES WITH JONATHAN PEARCE, BEN SINCLAIR AND IVAN LUKETINA-JOHNSTON — FOUR HIGHLY TRAINED MUSICIANS WHO HAD CROSSED PATHS THROUGH SCHOOL MUSIC PROGRAMS, THE UNIVERSITY OF AUCKLAND’S JAZZ SCHOOL AND THE CITY’S CLOSE-KNIT LIVE MUSIC COMMUNITY. BEFORE THE BETHS, THE MEMBERS HAD ALREADY BUILT IMPRESSIVE MUSICAL RESUMES. STOKES STUDIED TRUMPET, PEARCE PIANO, WHILE SINCLAIR STUDIED CLARINET AND SAXOPHONE. THEY HAD ALSO PLAYED TOGETHER IN LUKETINA-JOHNSTON’S JAZZ OUTFIT SAL VALENTINE & THE BABYSHAKES. PEARCE HAD PERFORMED WITH ARTISAN GUNS AND WORKED ALONGSIDE ARTISTS INCLUDING ALDOUS HARDING, LAWRENCE ARABIA AND TINY RUINS. STOKES’ CONNECTION TO GUITAR-BASED SONGWRITING STRETCHED BACK TO HER TEENAGE YEARS. SHE BEGAN LEARNING GUITAR AT 13 AND LATER FORMED FOLK TRIO TEACUPS WITH CHELSEA JADE AND TALITA SETYADI. WHILE HER JAZZ STUDIES DEVELOPED HER MUSICIANSHIP, SHE FOUND HERSELF MISSING THE DIRECTNESS OF SONGS, LYRICS AND THE GUITAR MUSIC SHE HAD GROWN UP LOVING. THE SPARK THAT WOULD EVENTUALLY BECOME THE BETHS CAME WHEN PEARCE ENCOURAGED STOKES TO START WRITING SONGS AGAIN SO HE COULD RECORD THEM. THE IDEA LINGERED, AND STOKES BEGAN IMAGINING MUSIC THAT WOULD ALLOW HER TO PICK UP A GUITAR AND PLAY IN A BAND. THE RESULT WAS THE BETHS: A DISTINCTIVE COLLISION OF BRIGHT, MELODIC GUITAR POP, TIGHT MUSICIANSHIP, LAYERED VOCAL HARMONIES AND LYRICS FILLED WITH ANXIETY, SELF-DOUBT, ROMANTIC CONFUSION AND SHARP SELF-DEPRECATION. STOKES HAS SUMMED UP THE CONTRAST PERFECTLY AS “SWEETLY SUNG MELODIES AND SUPER DEPRESSING LYRICS.” THAT TENSION BECAME CENTRAL TO THE BAND’S APPEAL. SUNNY MELODIES AND ENERGETIC GUITARS CAN MASK WORDS ABOUT INSECURITY, AWKWARDNESS AND EMOTIONAL TURMOIL, WHILE THE BAND’S FOUR-PART HARMONIES AND PRECISE ARRANGEMENTS REVEAL THE MUSICAL TRAINING BEHIND THE APPARENTLY EFFORTLESS INDIE-ROCK SOUND. DRAWING INFLUENCE FROM GUITAR-POP AND INDIE-ROCK ACTS SUCH AS WEEZER, RILO KILEY AND DEATH CAB FOR CUTIE, THE BETHS DEVELOPED A SOUND THAT FELT BOTH FAMILIAR AND COMPLETELY THEIR OWN. WHAT BEGAN AS FOUR JAZZ-SCHOOLED FRIENDS WANTING TO PLAY IN A GUITAR BAND GREW INTO AN INTERNATIONALLY RECOGNISED NEW ZEALAND INDIE SUCCESS STORY — BUILT ON GREAT SONGS, GLORIOUS HARMONIES, CRUNCHING GUITARS AND THE PECULIAR JOY OF SINGING SOMETHING DEVASTATING OVER MUSIC THAT MAKES YOU WANT TO SMILE. I CAN ALSO CUT THIS DOWN TO A **500-CHARACTER / 800-CHARACTER VERSION** IF THIS IS FOR YOUR AGGITS TICKER OR BAND DATABASE.
tickerCopy: *** THE BETHS *** ......AN AUCKLAND INDIE-POP BAND FORMED IN 2015, LED BY SINGER AND SONGWRITER ELIZABETH STOKES. KNOWN FOR BRIGHT GUITARS, TIGHT HARMONIES AND LYRICS FULL OF SELF-DOUBT, ANXIETY AND WRY HUMOUR, THEY TURN EMOTIONAL UNEASE INTO IRRESISTIBLY MELODIC GUITAR POP. WITH ROOTS IN JAZZ SCHOOL AND NEW ZEALAND’S LOCAL MUSIC SCENE, THE BAND HAS GROWN INTO ONE OF THE COUNTRY’S MOST DISTINCTIVE AND INTERNATIONALLY LOVED INDIE ACTS.
